# ProductosVirales.com.ar

## About
ProductosVirales is a curated product discovery platform for MercadoLibre Argentina. We publish in-depth, honest buying guides and individual product reviews (with real ARS prices, pros/cons, specs and FAQs) for products that go viral on TikTok and social media. Every recommendation includes cons, not just pros, and an affiliate disclosure.

## Content Types
- Buying guides: cluster pillars and comparisons (e.g. "Best air fryers in Argentina 2026", "Atma vs Peabody air fryer")
- Product pages: individual reviews with price, rating, specs, real customer reviews and FAQ
- Category pages: curated collections (Hogar, Cocina, Tech, Belleza)
